request_identity.normative_behavior: Outstanding requests have unique Requester/Function/Tag identities; retire after complete response or defined failure.
request_identity.reference_behavior: HTML aggregates per-Function budgets and uses fixed reference Tag ceilings.
request_identity.unsupported: No requester execution, Tag allocation, or response matching in M0.

memory_requests.normative_behavior: Apply request-specific MPS/MRRS, byte enables, length and 4 KiB boundary rules.
memory_requests.reference_behavior: HTML uses adjustable header byte costs and simplified request plans.
memory_requests.unsupported: No TLP generation, byte-enable execution, AtomicOps or I/O transactions in M0.

completion.normative_behavior: Validate status, Byte Count, Lower Address, increasing data addresses and full request coverage.
completion.reference_behavior: HTML selects MPS-filled or RCB-boundary segments, with idealized completion service.
completion.unsupported: No completion assembly or protocol error execution in M0.

rcb_role.normative_behavior: rcb_role identifies the System Element receiving the Read Completions: RC permits 64/128 B, endpoint requires 128 B.
rcb_role.reference_behavior: HTML retains RCB 64/128 without a receiver role; reference mode preserves either choice.
rcb_role.unsupported: Configuration constraint only; mixed roles, bridge-specific paths and runtime split validation are not implemented.

ordering.normative_behavior: Arbitrate only within permitted class/attribute/identity ordering and forward-progress relations.
ordering.reference_behavior: HTML uses FIFO aggregate Fabric service, not a complete ordering matrix.
ordering.unsupported: No runtime ordering, RO/IDO, Atomic or deadlock proof in M0.

virtual_channels.normative_behavior: TC-to-VC mapping and receive/transmit resources are distinct from physical channels.
virtual_channels.reference_behavior: HTML divides H/D estimates uniformly across vc and counts logical VOQs.
virtual_channels.unsupported: No runtime TC mapping, VC arbitration or flow control in M0.

flow_control.normative_behavior: Flit transmitters declare Shared FC support; receiver support is optional. Declaration does not imply modeled execution.
flow_control.reference_behavior: HTML returns credit on an ideal timer; TLP-budget execution will explicitly label FC approximations.
flow_control.unsupported: No dedicated/shared accounting, initialization, counter wrap or update events in M0.

flit_layout_replay.normative_behavior: Use 256-byte FLIT layout; retain protected TLP information and update DLP on retry without duplicate delivery.
flit_layout_replay.reference_behavior: HTML uses 236/256 times packing and replay-window bandwidth limiting.
flit_layout_replay.unsupported: No FLIT encoding, FEC, ACK/NAK, replay state machine or PHY execution in M0.

simai_integration.normative_behavior: Integrate AstraNetworkAPI after the gem5 cycle profile passes M3; share hardware runtime and causal completion feedback.
simai_integration.reference_behavior: HTML only exports sizing/calibration estimates; it is not a closed-loop SimAI backend.
simai_integration.unsupported: No SimAI backend, runtime bridge, callbacks or workload execution in M0.

limitations: No protocol execution or cycle backend exists in M0.
Reference Tag ceilings are not universal legal Tag sets.
Topology validates uniform root-to-endpoint switch counts; physical port/lane mapping and addresses remain unresolved.
RX/data/descriptor minima do not prove complete credit or core backing.
Errata/ECN coverage must be verified before claiming compliance.
